title: First link of the split image failed on 11 address-named symbols spimdisasm referenced but placed nowhere, plus one .L label referenced across a file split
observed: ld: undefined reference to D_00509100, D_536280, D_00510470, D_40000, D_00509380, D_FFFFFF ... (11) on the one-segment baseline; after adding a c subsegment at 0x77B80 the second file (main_b) referenced .L0010AF40 defined in main.s. configure.py now appends 'NAME = 0xADDR;' lines to config/undefined_syms.txt for address-named undefined symbols and relinks; the image then matches byte for byte.
expected: splat's undefined_syms_auto.txt covers every referenced symbol
hypothesis: spimdisasm treats data inside a region typed asm as instructions, so symbols that fall mid-instruction or in misdetected functions get no label; segment-map (S4) typing data regions as data will remove most of these. Unverified.

expected: ninja exit 0 after a complete build
